Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 41

“When lawlessness prevails, Krishna, the women of the family are corrupted; and when the women are corrupted, Varshneya, confusion of social order arises.”

This verse rests on the social assumptions of its own period rather than on any timeless claim. Arjuna's underlying fear is that a war's damage does not stop at the battlefield's edge.
